verdict.rationale: Ollama serves models and can be launched via coding agents, and OpenClaw (a third-party integration) offers a persistent assistant across messaging apps, but there is no evidence of native scheduling, task automation, or autonomous background execution management within Ollama itself. missing for 10: built-in scheduler/cron for autonomous runs, persistent background job management, first-party automation framework, independent confirmation of unattended agentic use.
